meta.title: Dissuade
meta.description: A kind reminder does not necessarily stem from concern.

units.rawText: At the Reverse Babylon Tower.
units.displayText: At the Reverse Babylon Tower.

spans.text: At the Reverse Babylon Tower.

units.rawText: The clear, crisp sound of Angelus' footsteps echo off the steps. Their tempo is somewhat quicker than usual.
units.displayText: The clear, crisp sound of Angelus' footsteps echo off the steps. Their tempo is somewhat quicker than usual.

spans.text: The clear, crisp sound of Angelus' footsteps echo off the steps. Their tempo is somewhat quicker than usual.

units.rawText: Please slow down, Lady Angelus!
units.displayText: Please slow down, Lady Angelus!

spans.text: Please slow down, Lady Angelus!

units.rawText: There isn't a moment to lose, I must head over to give support as soon as possible.
units.displayText: There isn't a moment to lose, I must head over to give support as soon as possible.

spans.text: There isn't a moment to lose, I must head over to give support as soon as possible.

units.rawText: It's alright if you can't keep up. Just follow after me with a medical team.
units.displayText: It's alright if you can't keep up. Just follow after me with a medical team.

spans.text: It's alright if you can't keep up. Just follow after me with a medical team.

units.rawText: Oh, if it isn't Big Sis Angelus?
units.displayText: Oh, if it isn't Big Sis Angelus?

spans.text: Oh, if it isn't Big Sis Angelus?

units.rawText: L-Lady Eucharist...
units.displayText: L-Lady Eucharist...

spans.text: L-Lady Eucharist...

units.rawText: Eucharist, are you going to show your face in public even in this tragic state of yours?
units.displayText: Eucharist, are you going to show your face in public even in this tragic state of yours?

spans.text: Eucharist, are you going to show your face in public even in this tragic state of yours?

units.rawText: If I were you, I would know some shame and remain obediently where I ought to be.
units.displayText: If I were you, I would know some shame and remain obediently where I ought to be.

spans.text: If I were you, I would know some shame and remain obediently where I ought to be.

units.rawText: Just as Angelus has said, right now Eucharist is a far cry from her usual self.
units.displayText: Just as Angelus has said, right now Eucharist is a far cry from her usual self.

spans.text: Just as Angelus has said, right now Eucharist is a far cry from her usual self.

units.rawText: Her gear is nowhere in sight, her mechanical wings have been removed, and the pride of a Greater Sanctifier has vanished without a trace.
units.displayText: Her gear is nowhere in sight, her mechanical wings have been removed, and the pride of a Greater Sanctifier has vanished without a trace.

spans.text: Her gear is nowhere in sight, her mechanical wings have been removed, and the pride of a Greater Sanctifier has vanished without a trace.

units.rawText: (Pouts) You just had to rub it in, didn't you?
units.displayText: (Pouts) You just had to rub it in, didn't you?

spans.text: (Pouts) You just had to rub it in, didn't you?

units.rawText: We Greater Sanctifiers have the right to exercise our own judgment over whether or not we need to move out. Since I was feeling bored, I came out for a stroll.
units.displayText: We Greater Sanctifiers have the right to exercise our own judgment over whether or not we need to move out. Since I was feeling bored, I came out for a stroll.

spans.text: We Greater Sanctifiers have the right to exercise our own judgment over whether or not we need to move out. Since I was feeling bored, I came out for a stroll.

units.rawText: Then let me generously remind you that not only have you been stripped of your privileges. You have also been sentenced to confinement, so that is one right you do not currently possess.
units.displayText: Then let me generously remind you that not only have you been stripped of your privileges. You have also been sentenced to confinement, so that is one right you do not currently possess.

spans.text: Then let me generously remind you that not only have you been stripped of your privileges. You have also been sentenced to confinement, so that is one right you do not currently possess.

units.rawText: Yes, yes, I know—Lord Eosphorus said I was to stay inside the Reverse Tower, I remember that.
units.displayText: Yes, yes, I know—Lord Eosphorus said I was to stay inside the Reverse Tower, I remember that.

spans.text: Yes, yes, I know—Lord Eosphorus said I was to stay inside the Reverse Tower, I remember that.

units.rawText: Don't go grabbing at my arm. Plastering yourself to me is most unsightly.
units.displayText: Don't go grabbing at my arm. Plastering yourself to me is most unsightly.

spans.text: Don't go grabbing at my arm. Plastering yourself to me is most unsightly.

units.rawText: I'm just trying to get closer to my big sister Angelus, now our hearts are one~
units.displayText: I'm just trying to get closer to my big sister Angelus, now our hearts are one~

spans.text: I'm just trying to get closer to my big sister Angelus, now our hearts are one~

units.rawText: <size=40>...Eucharist, that's enough!</size>
units.displayText: ...Eucharist, that's enough!

spans.text: ...Eucharist, that's enough!

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus is overseeing the border battlefront to keep the Entropy at bay and keep those chaotic Daemons from ravaging Magrasea.
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus is overseeing the border battlefront to keep the Entropy at bay and keep those chaotic Daemons from ravaging Magrasea.

spans.text: Lord Hesperus is overseeing the border battlefront to keep the Entropy at bay and keep those chaotic Daemons from ravaging Magrasea.

units.rawText: And now, those very same Entropics have appeared in the Pierides Sector. This is a very grave situation.
units.displayText: And now, those very same Entropics have appeared in the Pierides Sector. This is a very grave situation.

spans.text: And now, those very same Entropics have appeared in the Pierides Sector. This is a very grave situation.

units.rawText: I know that. I'm not actually an airhead, you know?
units.displayText: I know that. I'm not actually an airhead, you know?

spans.text: I know that. I'm not actually an airhead, you know?

units.rawText: I came because I thought you might regret heading out!
units.displayText: I came because I thought you might regret heading out!

spans.text: I came because I thought you might regret heading out!

units.rawText: Angelus comes to a halt.
units.displayText: Angelus comes to a halt.

spans.text: Angelus comes to a halt.

units.rawText: Regret, you say?
units.displayText: Regret, you say?

spans.text: Regret, you say?

units.rawText: ...Eucharist, are there any other places in urgent need of attention other than the Pierides Sector?
units.displayText: ...Eucharist, are there any other places in urgent need of attention other than the Pierides Sector?

spans.text: ...Eucharist, are there any other places in urgent need of attention other than the Pierides Sector?

units.rawText: See, Big Sis Angelus? You're always running around everywhere to help out, but you don't pay enough attention to the news within the Reverse Tower.
units.displayText: See, Big Sis Angelus? You're always running around everywhere to help out, but you don't pay enough attention to the news within the Reverse Tower.

spans.text: See, Big Sis Angelus? You're always running around everywhere to help out, but you don't pay enough attention to the news within the Reverse Tower.

units.rawText: The Entropics at the border battlefront are exceptionally belligerent; Lord Hesperus is requesting reinforcements.
units.displayText: The Entropics at the border battlefront are exceptionally belligerent; Lord Hesperus is requesting reinforcements.

spans.text: The Entropics at the border battlefront are exceptionally belligerent; Lord Hesperus is requesting reinforcements.

units.rawText: Although Little Raven's been sent over already, you should know that Raven has always been rash.
units.displayText: Although Little Raven's been sent over already, you should know that Raven has always been rash.

spans.text: Although Little Raven's been sent over already, you should know that Raven has always been rash.

units.rawText: Although I'm worried about the situation on the frontline, I'm still under confinement, so all I can do is plead with you, sister.
units.displayText: Although I'm worried about the situation on the frontline, I'm still under confinement, so all I can do is plead with you, sister.

spans.text: Although I'm worried about the situation on the frontline, I'm still under confinement, so all I can do is plead with you, sister.

units.rawText: Oh? You're usually so willful. Why are you being such a good girl now?
units.displayText: Oh? You're usually so willful. Why are you being such a good girl now?

spans.text: Oh? You're usually so willful. Why are you being such a good girl now?

units.rawText: Being punished for breaking confinement sucks! I want to make up for my past mistakes too~
units.displayText: Being punished for breaking confinement sucks! I want to make up for my past mistakes too~

spans.text: Being punished for breaking confinement sucks! I want to make up for my past mistakes too~

units.rawText: (Sighs) Things must be really bad if even Lord Hesperus had to ask for reinforcements.
units.displayText: (Sighs) Things must be really bad if even Lord Hesperus had to ask for reinforcements.

spans.text: (Sighs) Things must be really bad if even Lord Hesperus had to ask for reinforcements.

units.rawText: Will Little Raven actually be able to help Lord Hesperus out? I'm so worried about the Greater Sanctifiers at the border.
units.displayText: Will Little Raven actually be able to help Lord Hesperus out? I'm so worried about the Greater Sanctifiers at the border.

spans.text: Will Little Raven actually be able to help Lord Hesperus out? I'm so worried about the Greater Sanctifiers at the border.

units.rawText: She's too rash. Fighting the Entropics isn't a simple matter of destroying everything...
units.displayText: She's too rash. Fighting the Entropics isn't a simple matter of destroying everything...

spans.text: She's too rash. Fighting the Entropics isn't a simple matter of destroying everything...

units.rawText: ...But the situation in the Pierides Sector is just as urgent. I can't neglect either of them.
units.displayText: ...But the situation in the Pierides Sector is just as urgent. I can't neglect either of them.

spans.text: ...But the situation in the Pierides Sector is just as urgent. I can't neglect either of them.

units.rawText: If only the results of my trial were finalized, perhaps I'd be able to help share some of your burden, Big Sis Angelus. Unfortunately, Crime and Punishment of the Tribunal haven't returned yet, so I can't leave the Reverse Tower even if I wanted to help.
units.displayText: If only the results of my trial were finalized, perhaps I'd be able to help share some of your burden, Big Sis Angelus. Unfortunately, Crime and Punishment of the Tribunal haven't returned yet, so I can't leave the Reverse Tower even if I wanted to help.

spans.text: If only the results of my trial were finalized, perhaps I'd be able to help share some of your burden, Big Sis Angelus. Unfortunately, Crime and Punishment of the Tribunal haven't returned yet, so I can't leave the Reverse Tower even if I wanted to help.

units.rawText: What should I do, Big Sis Angelus?
units.displayText: What should I do, Big Sis Angelus?

spans.text: What should I do, Big Sis Angelus?

units.rawText: You can forget about these little schemes, Eucharist. It's no good trying to pressure me that way.
units.displayText: You can forget about these little schemes, Eucharist. It's no good trying to pressure me that way.

spans.text: You can forget about these little schemes, Eucharist. It's no good trying to pressure me that way.

units.rawText: Magrasea's safety is crucial. To that end, Raven is also a capable fighter, given that she bears the responsibility of being a Greater Sanctifier.
units.displayText: Magrasea's safety is crucial. To that end, Raven is also a capable fighter, given that she bears the responsibility of being a Greater Sanctifier.

spans.text: Magrasea's safety is crucial. To that end, Raven is also a capable fighter, given that she bears the responsibility of being a Greater Sanctifier.

units.rawText: The border battlefront is more important.
units.displayText: The border battlefront is more important.

spans.text: The border battlefront is more important.

units.rawText: ...Lord Eosphorus.
units.displayText: ...Lord Eosphorus.

spans.text: ...Lord Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Forgive me for not noticing your arrival.
units.displayText: Forgive me for not noticing your arrival.

spans.text: Forgive me for not noticing your arrival.

units.rawText: There is no need to stand on ceremony. Your consternation was only due to your concern, after all.
units.displayText: There is no need to stand on ceremony. Your consternation was only due to your concern, after all.

spans.text: There is no need to stand on ceremony. Your consternation was only due to your concern, after all.

units.rawText: I am ashamed to admit that I have neglected my surroundings.
units.displayText: I am ashamed to admit that I have neglected my surroundings.

spans.text: I am ashamed to admit that I have neglected my surroundings.

units.rawText: I was hoping to personally proceed to the Pierides Sector.
units.displayText: I was hoping to personally proceed to the Pierides Sector.

spans.text: I was hoping to personally proceed to the Pierides Sector.

units.rawText: Angelus, I understand your eagerness, for you value order and stability more than anyone else.
units.displayText: Angelus, I understand your eagerness, for you value order and stability more than anyone else.

spans.text: Angelus, I understand your eagerness, for you value order and stability more than anyone else.

units.rawText: From the reports I have received so far, an Intermediate Sanctifier will be enough to handle the Pierides Sector. I have dispatched Wisdom and a team to take care of it.
units.displayText: From the reports I have received so far, an Intermediate Sanctifier will be enough to handle the Pierides Sector. I have dispatched Wisdom and a team to take care of it.

spans.text: From the reports I have received so far, an Intermediate Sanctifier will be enough to handle the Pierides Sector. I have dispatched Wisdom and a team to take care of it.

units.rawText: You were the original pillar for our war effort against the Entropics on the border battlefront, so I do not doubt your judgment.
units.displayText: You were the original pillar for our war effort against the Entropics on the border battlefront, so I do not doubt your judgment.

spans.text: You were the original pillar for our war effort against the Entropics on the border battlefront, so I do not doubt your judgment.

units.rawText: But with the Entropics sowing such chaos, sending an Intermediate Sanctifier...
units.displayText: But with the Entropics sowing such chaos, sending an Intermediate Sanctifier...

spans.text: But with the Entropics sowing such chaos, sending an Intermediate Sanctifier...

units.rawText: I fear Wisdom is not capable of handling the matter in a suitable fashion if the Entropics mutate too severely.
units.displayText: I fear Wisdom is not capable of handling the matter in a suitable fashion if the Entropics mutate too severely.

spans.text: I fear Wisdom is not capable of handling the matter in a suitable fashion if the Entropics mutate too severely.

units.rawText: If any variables arise, I will personally take care of them.
units.displayText: If any variables arise, I will personally take care of them.

spans.text: If any variables arise, I will personally take care of them.

units.rawText: The true disaster for Magrasea would be if the defense line held by Hesperus is breached.
units.displayText: The true disaster for Magrasea would be if the defense line held by Hesperus is breached.

spans.text: The true disaster for Magrasea would be if the defense line held by Hesperus is breached.

units.rawText: ...You are correct.
units.displayText: ...You are correct.

spans.text: ...You are correct.

units.rawText: The situation on the border battlefront is extremely pressing. That is also the reason why I was hoping you would go there.
units.displayText: The situation on the border battlefront is extremely pressing. That is also the reason why I was hoping you would go there.

spans.text: The situation on the border battlefront is extremely pressing. That is also the reason why I was hoping you would go there.

units.rawText: Let Crime worry about how these Entropics infiltrated Magrasea in the first place.
units.displayText: Let Crime worry about how these Entropics infiltrated Magrasea in the first place.

spans.text: Let Crime worry about how these Entropics infiltrated Magrasea in the first place.

units.rawText: Your considerations are so thorough that I can find no fault with them.
units.displayText: Your considerations are so thorough that I can find no fault with them.

spans.text: Your considerations are so thorough that I can find no fault with them.

units.rawText: I will proceed to the frontlines now to help Lord Hesperus stabilize the battle conditions.
units.displayText: I will proceed to the frontlines now to help Lord Hesperus stabilize the battle conditions.

spans.text: I will proceed to the frontlines now to help Lord Hesperus stabilize the battle conditions.

units.rawText: Eosphorus nods.
units.displayText: Eosphorus nods.

spans.text: Eosphorus nods.

units.rawText: Angelus spreads her wings and flies off the peak of the Reverse Tower.
units.displayText: Angelus spreads her wings and flies off the peak of the Reverse Tower.

spans.text: Angelus spreads her wings and flies off the peak of the Reverse Tower.

units.rawText: Bye, Big Sis! Be careful!
units.displayText: Bye, Big Sis! Be careful!

spans.text: Bye, Big Sis! Be careful!

units.rawText: If you get completely Entropized over there, not even the Pantheon can save you...
units.displayText: If you get completely Entropized over there, not even the Pantheon can save you...

spans.text: If you get completely Entropized over there, not even the Pantheon can save you...

units.rawText: Contain yourself. You are still under punishment.
units.displayText: Contain yourself. You are still under punishment.

spans.text: Contain yourself. You are still under punishment.

units.rawText: (Pouts) Okie.
units.displayText: (Pouts) Okie.

spans.text: (Pouts) Okie.

units.rawText: But Lord Eosphorus, do I really have to wait here until Crime and Punishment return?
units.displayText: But Lord Eosphorus, do I really have to wait here until Crime and Punishment return?

spans.text: But Lord Eosphorus, do I really have to wait here until Crime and Punishment return?

units.rawText: That is the price you must pay for your willfulness. Any more and I will shrink the area of your confinement to just your room.
units.displayText: That is the price you must pay for your willfulness. Any more and I will shrink the area of your confinement to just your room.

spans.text: That is the price you must pay for your willfulness. Any more and I will shrink the area of your confinement to just your room.

units.rawText: What about the various sundry matters of Magrasea?
units.displayText: What about the various sundry matters of Magrasea?

spans.text: What about the various sundry matters of Magrasea?

units.rawText: Other than the Exiles of the Oasis, there are also a few weird agents running around between the sectors.
units.displayText: Other than the Exiles of the Oasis, there are also a few weird agents running around between the sectors.

spans.text: Other than the Exiles of the Oasis, there are also a few weird agents running around between the sectors.

units.rawText: Do you wish to investigate them?
units.displayText: Do you wish to investigate them?

spans.text: Do you wish to investigate them?

units.rawText: What if they end up being as interesting as the Exiles?
units.displayText: What if they end up being as interesting as the Exiles?

spans.text: What if they end up being as interesting as the Exiles?

units.rawText: Eosphorus looks down at Eucharist.
units.displayText: Eosphorus looks down at Eucharist.

spans.text: Eosphorus looks down at Eucharist.

units.rawText: The brown-haired girl blinks her gleaming eyes, the very image of innocence.
units.displayText: The brown-haired girl blinks her gleaming eyes, the very image of innocence.

spans.text: The brown-haired girl blinks her gleaming eyes, the very image of innocence.

units.rawText: Do you wish to make contact with these unknown agents, or explore other places?
units.displayText: Do you wish to make contact with these unknown agents, or explore other places?

spans.text: Do you wish to make contact with these unknown agents, or explore other places?

units.rawText: Both!
units.displayText: Both!

spans.text: Both!

units.rawText: I see.
units.displayText: I see.

spans.text: I see.

units.rawText: Yes, yes~
units.displayText: Yes, yes~

spans.text: Yes, yes~

units.rawText: It seems you require further discipline.
units.displayText: It seems you require further discipline.

spans.text: It seems you require further discipline.

units.rawText: Return to your room, Eucharist. You are forbidden to see anyone until your trial is complete.
units.displayText: Return to your room, Eucharist. You are forbidden to see anyone until your trial is complete.

spans.text: Return to your room, Eucharist. You are forbidden to see anyone until your trial is complete.

units.rawText: <size=44>Ehhhhhhh!?</size>
units.displayText: Ehhhhhhh!?

spans.text: Ehhhhhhh!?

units.rawText: >> CHAPTER 5 // END...
units.displayText: >> CHAPTER 5 // END...

spans.text: >> CHAPTER 5 // END...

units.rawText: Lord Eosphorus, Lady Eucharist, I have also assembled a force and we are prepared to depart with Lady Angelus.
units.displayText: Lord Eosphorus, Lady Eucharist, I have also assembled a force and we are prepared to depart with Lady Angelus.

spans.text: Lord Eosphorus, Lady Eucharist, I have also assembled a force and we are prepared to depart with Lady Angelus.
